translations.translation: And this is the connection of Yehudah's approach to Yosef to the linkage of redemption to prayer,
for in Yehudah's approach to Yosef, the superiority of Malchus relative to Zeir Anpin is emphasized,
in that through Zeir Anpin's influence to Malchus, an additional elevation is generated in Zeir Anpin.
And it is analogous to "great is study that brings to action,"
for through this, an enlargement is effected in study.
Based on this, one may also understand the connection of "Vayigash eilav Yehudah" with the haftarah of Parshat Vayigash, whose content is that in the future, Yehudah will be above Yosef,
for the elevation that is effected in Zeir Anpin through His influence to Malchus is a preparation for that
the superiority of Malchus itself will be revealed,
"and they shall serve Hashem their God and Dovid their king, whom I will raise up for them,"
with the coming of Mashiach Tzidkeinu, speedily and truly.
